scripts.text:
[Lilla]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Dryads?
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
你獵殺夠50只森林妖姬了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
嗯，你好像還沒獵殺夠50只...

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
Remember, I need help hunting Dryads so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺森林妖姬，去殺夠50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
確定要放棄狩獵嗎？
目前的任務進度都會清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
好吧，改變主意了就回來找我。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
I really need to gather ^00CE0050 Sharp Leafs^000000 for my garden tea party.
Do you have any?
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
我辦花園茶會，急需^00CE0050尖銳的葉子^000000。
你身上有嗎？

scripts.text: I have some Sharp Leafs
scripts.translation: 我有一些尖銳的葉子

scripts.text: What did you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
Hey, your a sweet little thing.
Thanks so much for helping me!
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
哎呀，你真貼心。
太謝謝你幫忙了！

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
Oh, I almost forgot. I have something for you ^_^
Thank you so much again for your help.
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
哎呀，差點忘了，我還有東西給你呢 ^_^
再次謝謝你的幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
Why, I may look cute and silly but please don't play games with me.
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
我看著也許可愛又傻氣，可別拿我尋開心哦。

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
I need ^00CE0050 Sharp Leafs^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
我需要^00CE0050尖銳的葉子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lilla]
Ah, ok I think you can help me out by hunting some Dryads.
How many would you like to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
好，那就幫我獵殺些森林妖姬吧。
你打算獵殺多少隻？

scripts.text: 50 Dryads
scripts.translation: 50只森林妖姬

scripts.text: 100 Dryads
scripts.translation: 100只森林妖姬

scripts.text: 150 Dryads
scripts.translation: 150只森林妖姬

scripts.translation:

完成任務後回來找我，我會給你一點獎勵。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

You are way too tiny to be helping me.
Thank you for your offer though.
scripts.translation:
[莉拉]
你太小了，幫不了我的忙。
不過還是謝謝你的好意。
